dataset: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Lounge Entitlements
description: Every Indian credit card that opens an airport or railway lounge, with the visits a year each side grants, the per-quarter ceiling where one binds, the spend gate in the issuer’s own terms, the programme behind the door, guest rules and announced changes not yet in effect. Read from issuer terms, not from a card’s marketing line. What a visit is worth is our valuation model and is not in this dataset. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Lounge Entitlements Dataset, live snapshot as of 2026-10-19. For a citable, immutable version see https://cardadvisor.in/data/versions.

fieldDictionary.cardKey: Stable identifier for the card; joins to the card-facts dataset and to /cards/<cardKey>.
fieldDictionary.cardName: Card name as the issuer markets it.
fieldDictionary.tier: ENTRY | MID | PREMIUM | SUPER_PREMIUM — CardAdvisor’s own tiering, not an issuer label.
fieldDictionary.domesticVisitsPerYear: Complimentary DOMESTIC airport lounge visits a year, where the terms state or imply a count. Null when access is granted without a published number, and null when unlimited (see domesticUnlimited).
fieldDictionary.domesticPerQuarter: The per-quarter ceiling, where the terms state one. Many issuers grant an annual figure AND a quarterly cap; both are published because only one of them binds a given trip.
fieldDictionary.domesticUnlimited: true where the terms grant unlimited domestic visits.
fieldDictionary.domesticPresent: true where domestic airport access exists at all, including where no count is published.
fieldDictionary.internationalVisitsPerYear: Complimentary INTERNATIONAL airport lounge visits a year, same rules as the domestic column.
fieldDictionary.internationalPerQuarter: The per-quarter ceiling on international visits, where stated.
fieldDictionary.internationalUnlimited: true where the terms grant unlimited international visits.
fieldDictionary.internationalPresent: true where COMPLIMENTARY international access exists. False on a card that merely issues a lounge membership whose visits are paid — see membershipOnly, which is a different thing and is why this column is not the same as "the card mentions international lounges".
fieldDictionary.railwayVisitsPerYear: Complimentary RAILWAY (IRCTC / station) lounge visits a year. A separate benefit from airport access and never added to it: 10 of the cards carrying one have no airport lounge at all.
fieldDictionary.railwayPerQuarter: The per-quarter ceiling on railway visits, where stated.
fieldDictionary.airportVisitsPerYear: domesticVisitsPerYear + internationalVisitsPerYear, published as the single comparable figure. Null when either side is unlimited, because an unlimited benefit has no annual number and giving it one would rank it below a card with a large finite count.
fieldDictionary.spendGate: gated | booking | none | unpublished | unknown. "none" is the terms explicitly saying there is no spend condition; "unknown" is the terms being silent, which is not the same claim.
fieldDictionary.spendGateAmountRs: The spend threshold in rupees, where the terms publish one.
fieldDictionary.spendGateWindow: The window that spend is measured over (e.g. previous-quarter, previous-month).
fieldDictionary.spendGateScope: domestic | international | all — which side of the benefit the gate is worded against. An issuer commonly gates only domestic access.
fieldDictionary.spendGateTiered: true where one clause carries more than one threshold (e.g. 1 visit at ₹50k, 2 at ₹75k). The published amount is then the first rung, not the whole rule.
fieldDictionary.programmes: The lounge programme(s) the access runs through — Priority Pass, DreamFolks, LoungeKey, Diners Club, Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex Global Lounge Collection. Pipe-separated in the CSV.
fieldDictionary.membershipOnly: true where the card issues a lounge membership but includes NO complimentary visits — you get the card, you pay per entry. Published because it reads as lounge access everywhere else and is not.
fieldDictionary.guestVisitsPerYear: Complimentary guest visits a year, where published.
fieldDictionary.guestsChargeable: true where guests are admitted but charged.
fieldDictionary.extraVisitCharge: The per-visit charge beyond the quota, in the issuer’s own units (often US$).
fieldDictionary.cardholders: primary-only | add-on-included | unknown — whether supplementary cardholders share the benefit.
fieldDictionary.upcomingChangeFrom: ISO date an announced change takes effect. Announced changes are NEVER folded into the columns above: a benefit that starts in October is not a benefit today.
fieldDictionary.upcomingChangeText: The announced change, in the issuer’s own wording.
